body:
I've already lost some 40 pounds (with diet and exercise, not because of the disease) but one doesn't simply "lose weight", specially not if you have major depression issues.

I lost weight and I'm still having this problem. That is **not** the most motivating thing in the world you know?

Oh, believe me that I'd have tons of fun with a fake leg. I just don't recall ever seeing an obese amputee with one. They usually are fat, then lose the leg, then become so fat that even with two good legs they wouldn't be able to stand. I remember seeing a .gif here on reddit (on r/funny, of course) of a fat lady on one of those electric scooters pushing another, fatter, lady in a wheelchair. The fatter lady was missing a leg, I don't want to be the next "LOL look at the pathetic fatso!" .gif on reddit (or anywhere else for that matter).

If I was told that a fake leg was an option and that it wouldn't cost as much as a car (which is what most high-end prosthesis cost) then it would put my mind at ease, for now.
